en.headline: CHP records new mpox case; 26-year-old man in stable condition
en.dek: Patient had two high-risk contacts with a man outside Hong Kong during the incubation period; total cases since 2022 reach 100, all male.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said on Saturday it is investigating a confirmed mpox case involving a 26-year-old man who is currently in stable condition.

The patient developed papules on his genital area from 29 August that later spread to his face, limbs and trunk. He called the CHP hotline on 3 September and was arranged for isolation treatment at Tuen Mun Hospital. Laboratory testing of clinical specimens confirmed infection with the monkeypox virus.

According to the patient, he had two high-risk exposures with a man outside Hong Kong during the incubation period. The CHP will report the case to the World Health Organization and its investigation continues.

Since 2022 Hong Kong has recorded 100 mpox cases, all involving male patients. The centre again urged high-risk groups to receive mpox vaccination and advised the public to avoid close physical contact with anyone suspected of having the infection.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心錄得一宗猴痘確診 26歲男情況穩定
zh.dek: 患者潛伏期內在港以外與一名男子有兩次高風險接觸；自2022年起累計100宗個案，全部為男性。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日（5日）表示，正調查一宗猴痘確診個案，患者為26歲男子，目前情況穩定。
患者自上月29日起生殖器官出現丘疹，其後擴散至面部、四肢及軀幹。他於9月3日致電中心熱線，中心隨即安排他到屯門醫院接受隔離治療。臨床樣本經化驗後證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應。
根據患者提供的資料，他於潛伏期內曾於香港以外地方與一名男子有兩次高風險接觸。中心會將個案通報世界衞生組織，調查仍然繼續。
自2022年起至今，本港共錄得100宗猴痘個案，全部病人均為男性。中心再次強烈建議高風險目標群組人士接種猴痘疫苗，並呼籲市民提高警覺，避免與懷疑感染猴痘的人士作密切身體接觸。
